description: This Java class 'BenchTestPane' constructs a GUI panel with various vehicle component tests (e.g., fan, fuel pump, spark, injector, MIL, idle, dizzy) and buttons for sequences and research, integrating external UI components and command controls.

classes.name: BenchTestPane
classes.description: A GUI panel for executing various vehicle component tests and displaying messages.

methods.name: BenchTestPane
methods.description: Constructor initializing the panel with test components and buttons.

methods.name: createMILTest
methods.description: Creates a panel for MIL (Check Engine Light) test command.

methods.name: createIdleTest
methods.description: Creates a panel for Idle Valve test command.

methods.name: createDizzyTest
methods.description: Creates a panel for Dizzy (distributor) test command.

methods.name: createFanTest
methods.description: Creates a panel for Radiator Fan test command.

methods.name: createFuelPumpTest
methods.description: Creates a panel for Fuel Pump test command.

methods.name: createSparkTest
methods.description: Creates a panel for Spark plug test with selectable index.

methods.name: createInjectorTest
methods.description: Creates a panel for Injector test with selectable index.

methods.name: createIndexCombo
methods.description: Creates a combo box with indices 1 to 12 for selecting injectors or spark channels.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel containing all test components.
